_comment: The shipped version, and the oldest one still allowed to play. ONE source of truth: tools/build-web.js copies this into dist/ so GitHub Pages serves it at /lumen/release.json, .github/workflows/mobile.yml checks it against the version being built, and js/update.js fetches it on launch to decide whether an installed app is out of date.
_releaseOrder: `build` must never name a build that is not INSTALLABLE yet. Advertising one sends every player to a store that says they are already current, and then tells them again tomorrow -- a loop they cannot escape. So the bump comes LAST: ship the binary, wait for it to go live on both stores, then raise `build` here and push. The push redeploys Pages, and only then do older installs start seeing the prompt.
_minBuild: The hard block, with no way to dismiss it. Leave at 0. Move it only for a build that is genuinely unsafe to keep playing -- it locks out everyone below it.
